current_state_facts.phase5_pmsd_dark_contract: VERIFIED on the DEVELOPMENT appliance under T0052. pmsd is the one StayConnect daemon that is healthy when dead: with no Phase-3 flag set every flag resolves OFF and pmsd.Run returns immediately with no assignment, database pool, decrypted secret, worker or PMS socket, logs that fact and exits 0, and Restart=on-failure means the clean exit does not restart. The criterion therefore sits OUTSIDE the is-active loop and measures the contract in six arms: loaded+enabled; inactive/dead with Result=success and exit 0; NRestarts=0 with exactly one start this boot and zero storm indicators; the daemon's own dark statement and clean stop in this boot's journal; zero processes and zero sockets; zero attributable database backends. All six measured clean on radius (172.21.60.23).
